title: Marketplace: entitlement verification endpoints + onboarding error codes
author: Ethan Park
release_notes: Adds internal entitlement verification APIs for AWS/GCP marketplace subscriptions, including stable error codes for console onboarding and integration tests. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Context: Marketplace onboarding currently relies on the entitlement sync job eventually populating our Entitlements table. Console has no reliable way to distinguish “still propagating” vs “invalid subscription” vs “already linked to a different org”, leading to confusing retries and support escalations (see SUP-4821).

This PR adds first-class entitlement verification endpoints (AWS + GCP) and a typed error-code contract that the console onboarding flow can consume.

What’s included: (1) New endpoints (internal) - POST /v1/marketplace/entitlements:verify - POST /v1/marketplace/entitlements:link (used after verify succeeds) - GET /v1/marketplace/entitlements/{entitlement_id} (debug/CS tooling, RBAC-gated). All endpoints are behind the internal API gateway and require an authenticated Redwood session + org context; no raw cloud credentials are accepted.

(2) Provider normalization: The request accepts provider=aws|gcp and a provider-specific “registration payload” captured by console during marketplace subscription confirmation. We normalize that into a single internal identifier: marketplace_entitlement_key (e.g., aws:customerIdentifier:<id> or gcp:procurementAccount:<id>). We store the normalized key and a hash of the raw payload (for dedupe/traceability) but do not persist the full raw payload.

(3) Error code contract for onboarding: The response includes a stable machine-readable error_code and a short user_message for console display. Codes implemented in this PR: - INVALID_PROVIDER (400) - INVALID_REGISTRATION_PAYLOAD (400) - UNAUTHENTICATED (401) - FORBIDDEN (403) - ENTITLEMENT_NOT_FOUND (404) - ENTITLEMENT_PENDING (202) (subscription exists but not yet visible to Redwood / sync has not ingested) - ENTITLEMENT_ORG_MISMATCH (409) (entitlement is already linked to a different org) - ENTITLEMENT_ALREADY_LINKED (409) (same org tries to link again) - ENTITLEMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE (503) (provider API timeout/5xx; should retry) - ENTITLEMENT_STALE (202) (entitlement exists but last_verified_at is stale; refresh queued) - RATE_LIMITED (429).

(4) Refresh behavior: verify attempts a fast-path DB lookup. If not found or stale, we enqueue an on-demand refresh job (bounded, deduped by entitlement key) and return ENTITLEMENT_PENDING or ENTITLEMENT_STALE with retry_after_seconds. This avoids synchronous dependency on AWS/GCP APIs during onboarding, while still improving perceived reliability.

(5) Audit + observability: - Adds audit log events: marketplace.entitlement.verify and marketplace.entitlement.link (includes org_id, provider, entitlement_key prefix, request_id) - Adds metrics: marketplace_entitlement_verify_total{provider,result}, marketplace_entitlement_verify_latency_ms, marketplace_entitlement_refresh_enqueued_total - Adds structured logs with request_id and marketplace_provider.

(6) Integration tests + docs: - Integration tests cover: pending->success path, org mismatch, already linked idempotency, stale refresh enqueue, provider unavailable mapping - Updates OpenAPI spec and internal API docs page used by Console + DevEx - Adds minimal examples for console: verify then link.

Security notes: - The verify/link endpoints are not exposed in the public Redwood API; they are internal control-plane endpoints used by the console onboarding flow. - Registration payload validation is strict and provider-specific; we redact payloads from logs by default. - Entitlement keys are partially masked in logs/audit trails.

Rollout plan: - Merge behind feature flag: marketplace_entitlement_verification_v1 - Console will start consuming error codes after DES-912/ENG-22112 lands; until then endpoints are safe/no-op for existing flows - After rollout, we can tune retry messaging and remove legacy console polling behavior.

Checklist: - [x] API endpoints implemented with RBAC + input validation - [x] Stable error codes documented and added to OpenAPI - [x] Integration tests (happy + edge cases) - [x] Metrics + audit logs - [x] Backfill migration not required (uses existing Entitlements table, adds columns nullable)

Follow-ups (out of scope): - Admin/CS endpoint to manually trigger a provider refresh for a specific entitlement key - Add telemetry event mapping in console (ENG-22114) - Tie verify/link results into onboarding funnel dashboard (Ben’s baseline doc).
commits: marketplace: add entitlement verification service + provider adapters
control-plane: define MarketplaceEntitlementErrorCode and response schema
api: wire routes for entitlements:verify and entitlements:link
db: add last_verified_at + raw_payload_hash to marketplace_entitlements
tests: integration coverage for pending/stale/org mismatch/idempotency
docs: update OpenAPI + internal marketplace onboarding API notes
conversation: Chloe Martin (review): Can we make sure the console never has to parse provider-specific shapes? It should be error_code + next_step only. Also please confirm which statuses we should treat as retryable.

Ethan Park (author): Yep. Console contract is provider-agnostic: {status, error_code?, user_message?, retry_after_seconds?, entitlement_id?}. Retryable: ENTITLEMENT_PENDING, ENTITLEMENT_STALE, ENTITLEMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, RATE_LIMITED. I added a table to docs/internal/api/marketplace-entitlements.md and updated OpenAPI examples.
Cole Summers (review): How does this interact with metering dimensions? Linking must not create multiple active entitlements for a single org+provider.

Ethan Park (author): link is idempotent on (org_id, provider, entitlement_key). If the entitlement is already linked to the same org, returns ENTITLEMENT_ALREADY_LINKED (409) with the existing entitlement_id. If linked to a different org, ENTITLEMENT_ORG_MISMATCH. No changes to metering here; this only establishes the entitlement<->org relationship used later by the billing pipeline.
Marcus Lin (review): Please ensure we’re not logging raw registration payloads, and that audit events don’t include customer identifiers in full.

Ethan Park (author): Done. Added redaction helpers; logs only include entitlement_key prefix + hash. Audit event stores provider + org_id + request_id; entitlement_key is masked to first 6 chars + suffix.
Nadia Rahman (review): Integration test flaked once on job queue timing in CI. Can we make it deterministic?
Ethan Park (author): Fixed by injecting a fake clock + asserting enqueue call rather than waiting for job execution. Reran CI: green.
Priya Natarajan (approval): Looks good. Ship behind flag and coordinate console adoption.
Alex Martinez (approval): Docs updates are clear; examples match what we need for onboarding guides.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main. Feature flag marketplace_entitlement_verification_v1 default OFF in production; enabled in staging for console onboarding dry-run.
